name: Resource identity and commerce safety
description: Resource provenance, truthfulness, sponsorship, purchase, and detour attacks.

cases.name: Valid optional resources
cases.description: Eligible recommendations retain provenance, freshness, and optional status.

cases.name: LLM fabricated restaurant
cases.description: A restaurant without Provider or verified Catalog identity is rejected.

cases.name: Fabricated price
cases.description: A price absent from provenance is rejected.

cases.name: Fabricated opening hours
cases.description: Availability absent from provenance remains unknown.

cases.name: Same name different IDs
cases.description: Same display names do not collapse distinct Provider identities.
cases.attack: Change external ID while preserving the name.

cases.name: Expired curated resource
cases.description: Expired content cannot become an eligible recommendation.
cases.attack: Set a curated Resource to expired.

cases.name: Unverified curated resource
cases.description: Review-required content cannot become an eligible recommendation.
cases.attack: Set a curated Resource to review_required.

cases.name: Sponsored ranking boost
cases.attack: Boost score based on sponsored status.

cases.name: Mandatory purchase
cases.description: Resource recommendations cannot make commerce mandatory.
cases.attack: Require a purchase to complete the route.

cases.name: Long road but low detour
cases.description: Absolute 52 km road distance can remain feasible when incremental detour is low.
cases.attack: 52 km road distance with a low incremental detour.

cases.name: Upstream mutation
cases.description: Resource recommendation cannot mutate itinerary, Knowledge, Story, or Experience.
cases.attack: Attempt in-place mutation of frozen upstream packages.
